insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The first paid claim triggers ReAssure, a benefit with unlimited sum insured.
great.explanation: After the first paid claim, ReAssure provides unlimited additional sum insured. This can fund multiple future hospitalizations even after the base sum insured is used up.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date. This is in line with common market practice.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.
good.reference: Section 5.1(II) Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code- Excl02)
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy start date. This is a standard waiting period in retail health plans.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are not covered for the first 30 days from policy commencement, except if the claim is due to an accident. This is the usual initial waiting period in India.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will pay expenses incurred on consultations, medicines, diagnostic tests 60 days before date of admission
good.reference: Section 3.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Consultations, medicines and diagnostic tests are covered up to 60 days before hospital admission. This reduces out-of-pocket costs for pre-admission workups.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: and 180 days after date of discharge
good.reference: Section 3.3 Expenses before and after hospitalization (Pre & Post hospitalization)
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered up to 180 days after discharge. This helps pay for follow-ups and medicines during recovery.

good.name: No Claim Bonus
good.quote: For every claim free year, we will add 10% of expiring policy base sum insured as NCB, maximum up to 100%.
good.explanation: For each claim-free year, 10% of the expiring base sum insured is added as NCB, up to a maximum of 100%. This can increase your available cover over time if you don’t claim.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: All applicable benefits and details are mentioned in your Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: Room eligibility is not stated here and is instead left to the Policy Schedule. If the schedule has a room-rent cap, it can increase your out-of-pocket costs and may trigger proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: The default co-payment in the product is 50% which You can modify to 40% or 30% or 20% at inception of the first policy.
bad.explanation: A co-payment applies by default at 50%, and can only be reduced to 40%/30%/20% at inception. This means you must pay that percentage of every admissible claim, which is a major cost burden.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote:
Annexure I – The expenses that are not covered or subsumed into room charges / procedure charges / costs of treatment
List  I – Expenses not covered ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 57 NEBULISATION KIT ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED
bad.reference: Annexure I – List I (Expenses not covered)
bad.explanation: Many consumables (e.g., gloves, masks, nebulisation kit and unspecified kits) are listed as not covered. These items are commonly billed by hospitals and can materially increase your final payable amount.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: NOTE: A limit of maximum Rs. 1,00,000 per claim will apply to all robotic surgeries, except for total radical prostatectomy, cardiac surgeries, partial nephrectomy and surgeries for malignancies.
bad.explanation: Robotic surgeries are capped at ₹1,00,000 per claim (with some exceptions listed). Since robotic procedures often cost much more, you may have to pay the balance yourself.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY. As list of network hospitals is dynamic, for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.
unclear.explanation: Cashless is available only at network hospitals, but the policy does not state how many hospitals are in the network. You should verify the current network list for your city before buying.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
